stage.value: watching and bidding in a live show

job.value: watch the stream and place a bid

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Charizard VMAX — PSA 10', 'Lot 3 of 8', 'S$88 Current bid' and live chat read as a live auction.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width 'Swipe to bid →' bar is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Swipe to bid' and 'Shop' say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Lot 3 of 8' and 'Current bid' are plain, but the '<1d' next to the seller rating is unexplained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Only the bid decision is asked, with 'Next bid: S$90' shown.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The screen is pared to lot, bid, chat and shop.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: All elements belong to watching and bidding.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and values carry it with no prose.
